result.summary: The page is mostly well-structured, but there is a noticeable layout issue near the bottom where content sits underneath the fixed navigation bar, and one restaurant card title is truncated awkwardly in the horizontal row.

issues.description: The lower restaurant card in the "Popular right now" section is partially obscured by the fixed bottom navigation bar, making the content look clipped and harder to interact with.
issues.suggestion: Add enough bottom padding/margin to the scrollable content so the fixed navigation bar does not cover cards and buttons.

issues.description: The restaurant name in the horizontal row on the right is cut off with an awkward truncation ('Trattoria Picco...'), which makes the label feel visually cramped.
issues.suggestion: Allow a little more width, use a cleaner ellipsis strategy, or shorten the displayed title to improve readability.
